description: Binds the React Learning Studio panel to the Codex Learning Studio teaching splash demo evidence (DETERMINEX_LEARNING_STUDIO_TEACHING_SPLASH_DEMO_LOCK_001) read-only. Adds a read-only Tauri command get_learning_studio_verified_demo_status, a Python loader at scripts/ide/learning_studio_verified_demo_status.py, and a React component at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/LearningStudioVerifiedDemoStatus.tsx. The loader reads the most recent run_*.json under assurance/evidence/learning_studio_teaching_splash_demo/ and returns PASSED only if (1) status == LEARNING_STUDIO_TEACHING_SPLASH_DEMO_PASSED; (2) source_mutation_authorized / training_eligible / training_rows_written / approval_authority_granted / release_ready / authority.real_user_source_mutation_authorized / authority.broad_claims_granted are all NOT True; (3) non_authorizing_teaching_only == True; (4) verification.learning_success_label.success_label_allowed is NOT True; (5) beginner_explanation_written / pro_explanation_written / failure_explanation_written / safe_next_steps_written / what_this_does_not_prove_written / verifier_grounding_present are all True; (6) claim_boundary includes 'Learning Studio explanation only', 'non-authorizing teaching only', 'no source mutation authorized', 'not all projects', 'not all languages', 'not all users', 'training remains false', and 'release readiness remains false'; (7) no affirmative forbidden broad-claim phrase appears outside verification.*, claim_boundary, blocked_path_demo, evidence.claim_scanner_result, explanations, or source_evidence_summary. If the evidence file is not present locally, returns AWAITING_EVIDENCE; if status != PASSED returns BLOCKED_MALFORMED; the React component surfaces an 'Awaiting Codex reconciliation' or 'Binding blocked' banner accordingly. The component renders decision, target surface (Learning Studio), target workflow (non-authorizing verifier-grounded teaching and explanation), teaching subject, beginner/professional/failure-explanation-written flags, verifier-grounding flag, safe-next-steps-written flag, what-this-does-not-prove-written flag, non-authorizing-teaching-only badge, source_mutation_authorized=false / approval_authority_granted=false / training_eligible=false / training_rows_written=false / release_ready=false / broad_claims_granted=false captions, evidence_ref, final_report_path, evidence_manifest_path, source evidence paths (Repo Clinic + Maintenance Bay), explanation text sections (beginner, professional, what_failed, why_fix_or_update_worked, safe_next_steps, what_this_does_not_prove), a claim-boundary section, a blocked-path-summary section, and the required captions ('Ready does NOT mean authorized.', 'Learning can explain; it cannot mutate code.', 'Verified only for this Learning Studio teaching splash path.', 'Source mutation remains false.', 'Approval authority remains false.', 'Training stays false.', 'Release readiness remains false.', 'No all-projects, all-languages, all-users, arbitrary-teaching, production-ready, or autonomous-repair claim is granted.', 'Teaching explanations are grounded in existing verifier evidence, not new authorization.'). It NEVER surfaces: all projects / all codebases / all languages / all users / arbitrary teaching / arbitrary repair / autonomous repair / production-ready / real user repo mutation authorized / training enabled / source_mutation_authorized: true / release_ready: true claims.
purpose: Bind the verified Learning Studio teaching splash demo evidence into the live React Learning Studio panel as a non-authorizing teaching status.
